# T34 supplemental review, PR #150 at 7f1860d (agy Sonnet)

This is a limited supplemental review. It does not approve the task, and it does not replace the MiniMax merge review.

**Verdict: rework.** R1 is blocking. R2 needs an owner decision.

**Tree proof**
- `git rev-parse HEAD` returned `7f1860dac78932629340c561e8fae4cfcdf44589`.
- `git status --short` showed only untracked `.agents/` and `node_modules`. Nothing is modified.
- `git diff --stat` against base 9215373 shows 486 files, +1,207,433 and −1. The −1 is the clock-fix line. The top of the stat list was truncated, so I did not see every file name.
- The source diff output was also truncated at its start. Its shown tail and line count are consistent with only [island-geography.ts](file:///home/diego/projects/malpaco/.cache/agy-t34-review/src/core/island-geography.ts), [the test](file:///home/diego/projects/malpaco/.cache/agy-t34-review/tests/core/island-geography.test.ts) and [reference-complete-game.spec.ts](file:///home/diego/projects/malpaco/.cache/agy-t34-review/tests/e2e/reference-complete-game.spec.ts) changing under `src` and `tests`. This is likely, not proven.

## Done-when

- **DW1:** ran `npx vitest run tests/core/island-geography.test.ts` → 1 file, **10/10 passed** (1.42 s).
  - Success checks cover only seeds 0, 1, 7, 42, 99 and 1994. "All exported successes" rests on the sweep, which I did not run.
  - The geometry checks (overlaps, gaps, adjacency, degree headroom) are delegated to [acceptance.mjs](file:///home/diego/projects/malpaco/.cache/agy-t34-review/docs/prototypes/new-game/T34/acceptance.mjs), which calls the T62/T24 checkers.
- **DW2:** not run. `node docs/prototypes/new-game/T34/sweep.mjs` writes an evidence directory, and I was told not to write files.
  - I did read the retained report, [sweep-XOJBkB/report.json](file:///home/diego/projects/malpaco/.cache/agy-t34-review/docs/prototypes/new-game/T34/evidence/sweep-XOJBkB/report.json). It claims 100/100 successes, `failureCounts: {}`, 100 geometry hashes and 4 topology hashes.
  - That is the PR's own evidence, not a run of mine.
- **DW3:** not run (`npm test`, `npm run build`, the pinned browser suites).
  - I have not verified the claimed 603 units and 24 browsers.
  - I have not verified that the e2e clock fix passes.

## Findings

**R1 (blocking, likely) — [island-geography.ts:217-221](file:///home/diego/projects/malpaco/.cache/agy-t34-review/src/core/island-geography.ts#L217-L221) and [the test, lines 10-13 and 31-33](file:///home/diego/projects/malpaco/.cache/agy-t34-review/tests/core/island-geography.test.ts#L10-L13): the retry, failure-history and exhaustion behaviour has no test that exercises it.**
- Retained evidence shows `failureCounts: {}` for seeds 0..99. Every seed succeeds on attempt 1, so `failures` is always empty.
- In the 10 tests, the `failures` loop at lines 12-13 appears never to run with real data. I am inferring this from the sweep evidence and did not rerun it.
- The only exhaustion test uses `attempts: 0`, which has no failure records.
- Deleting `failures.push(...)` or the retry loop would likely still pass all 10 tests. I did not mutate the source because this review is read-only, so this is **unverified**.
- This weakens the Done-when requirement of "no discarded failures" and the record-every-rejected-attempt promise in CONTRACT.md.
- The PR also says the removal of `repairReservations` was caught only by the sweep (77/100). The unit tests may not catch it either (unverified).
- Needed: a test with a forced or scripted rejection that checks the failure records, the attempt count and the `ok:false` result with failures. Also add the missing clamp tests: `attempts` of 51, `NaN` and `Infinity`.

**R2 (user decision, likely) — [island-geography.ts:121-160](file:///home/diego/projects/malpaco/.cache/agy-t34-review/src/core/island-geography.ts#L121-L160) and [:94-120](file:///home/diego/projects/malpaco/.cache/agy-t34-review/src/core/island-geography.ts#L94-L120): the "seeded silhouettes" are one fixed witness with tiny perturbations.**
- Per axis, the warp expands each of 4 intervals by 0 to 0.5 px (line 124). Placement jitter is ±1 px (line 126).
- Beyond that, the only variation is a whole-board reflection and one local flip per eligible island. The sweep measures just 4 topologies.
- "100 distinct geometry hashes" is therefore trivially met, because a 1-unit change gives a new hash.
- The scope says "a single reference does not prove generality" and asks for island placement and orientation. Here orientation is only a global mirror.
